answer: An copycat therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The dawn counter is kept in ferrous and comet shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2423 identities would post 2276 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
